subject.title: Preserve Open WebUI UUID sessions across Control UI

question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the UUID session fix after removing the Codex/provider transport changes, or retarget the useful UUID work into the broader raw-alias session contract?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not one mechanical patch: maintainers need to choose the persistent session-alias owner boundary and reject, split, or separately review unrelated provider/auth transport changes before any merge path is safe.

options.title: Split and narrow this PR
options.body: Keep only the Open WebUI UUID session identity repair, rebase it onto current session-accessor and Control UI code, and require real Open WebUI plus Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Retarget to raw-alias work
options.body: Preserve any useful UUID tests but move the fix into the broader raw external alias implementation if maintainers want one shared alias contract.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close this stale conflicting branch after opening or selecting a narrower replacement that does not carry unrelated Codex/provider runtime changes.

recommendation.title: Split and narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Keep only the Open WebUI UUID session identity repair, rebase it onto current session-accessor and Control UI code, and require real Open WebUI plus Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session storage and Control UI boundaries blame to steipete's recent work, making him the best available owner for this merge-risk choice.
